name: CDC Marsden Park MP1 Stage 1 (MP1.S1 / MP1.1, 5 MW)

address.note: Panel determination: 'DA-24-00542 - 105 Hollinsworth Road, Marsden Park'. PlanningAlerts lodgement entry lists 105 and 113 Hollinsworth Road (source 8); part of the CDC Marsden Park campus (Lots 10-11 DP1262052), building sits beside MP1.S2 (see cdc-mp1).

lat.note: Geocoded from street address via NSW Spatial Services GNAF address point for '105 HOLLINSWORTH ROAD MARSDEN PARK' (-33.722609, 150.836600). Address point for the whole campus lot, not the building centroid (same point as cdc-mp1).

builder.note: Not verified. iCost (consultant) project page, seen only as a search extract, names Hindmarsh Constructions as head contractor for an AU$65m CDC Marsden Park data centre package (plausibly this 5 MW building given its $53.94m EDC); the page returns HTTP 404 and Hindmarsh's website (projects list, site search) has no CDC/Marsden Park entry (checked 2026-09-27). Built Pty Ltd is head contractor for the later SSD works (cdc-mp1) and lists 'CDC MP1.1 Operational Facility' as a separate stakeholder (source 6).

developer.note: Council assessment report: applicant/owner CDC Data Centres Pty Ltd.

mw_it.note: Panel/DA description: 'Construction of a 5-megawatt data centre facility'; SSD EIS Table 4: 'two (2) data halls with a capacity of 5MW' (source 5); Built CEMP: 'single storey data centre building with 2 data halls a capacity of 5-megawatts' (source 6). Treated as IT capacity because the campus 504 MW IT total = 79 MW (MP1.S2) + 5 x 84 MW + 5 MW (this building); sources do not label the 5 MW explicitly as IT load. CEMP drawings also show an adjoining 'MP1.EXT 7.5MW PORTION' (not part of this DA).

mw_grid.note: Not stated. Four generators and 20 chillers (source 5).

cost_aud_m.note: Planning panel page: CIV $53,940,000; SSD EIS Table 4: 'Estimated Development Cost $53,940,000 including GST' (source 5); council report CIV $53,940,000 (source 3). iCost snippet (unverified, source 10) gives a AU$65m contract value.

authority.value: Sydney Central City Planning Panel (Blacktown City Council DA)
authority.note: Regionally significant development (EDC > $30m) determined by SCCPP, PPSSCC-562; decision unanimous.

pathway.value: Regionally significant DA (council DA determined by planning panel)

reference.note: Also PAN-435950 (NSW Planning Portal application number, source 5). s4.55(1A) modification to extend construction hours listed on PlanningAlerts 8 Jan 2025 (source 9).

lodged.note: Panel page lodgement date 03/06/2024, referral 17/06/2024; council report and SSD EIS also give 3 June 2024.

determined.note: Panel determination 'DATE OF DETERMINATION 14 November 2024' (papers circulated electronically 11 Nov 2024). SSD-70889211 Assessment Report table gives 13 Nov 2024 (source 4).

jobs_construction.note: No building-specific construction jobs figure found (campus-level figures are in cdc-mp1).

jobs_operational.note: Council assessment report s8.2.3: 'the applicant only proposes 25 staff and maximum 5 visitors to attend this facility.'

jobs_operational_other.note: SSD EIS Table 7 'Forecast Operational Employment Generation Across Campus', '5MW (inc. gatehouse)' column: 12 office staff, 3 security, 5 visitors, 5 contractor = 25 (includes visitors). Counted within the campus total of 265 in cdc-mp1.

construction_start.note: Exact start not found. Campus ground-breaking 25 Oct 2024 (source 7) preceded the 14 Nov 2024 determination; a modification to extend construction hours was lodged Jan 2025 (source 9); SSD Assessment Report (Nov 2025) says emission-generating works were 'currently underway on-site via separate Council approvals (DA-24-00386 and DA-24-00542)'.

construction_end.note: approximate: partial occupation certificate OC-25-02215 listed by PlanningAlerts 28 Oct 2025; full completion date not found

open_questions: Operational status rests on Built's CEMP naming 'CDC MP1.1 Operational Facility' (and assumes MP1.1 = MP1.S1); completion / go-live date not found
Builder: Hindmarsh Constructions per iCost search extract only (page now 404; not on Hindmarsh website) - unverified
Relationship to 'MP1.EXT' (7.5 MW portion on CEMP drawings, under construction by Built in Mar 2026) unclear - may be an extension of this building under the SSD
5 MW treated as IT load by inference from campus arithmetic (504 = 79 + 5x84 + 5); not explicitly labelled IT
status 'operational' accepted on available evidence (decision 2026-09-27); confirm when a commencement/completion record appears
